grammar.title: I'm afraid that... with 恐怕
grammar.explanation: 恐怕 (kǒngpà) means "I'm afraid that..., probably" — used to soften a negative guess or worry, showing the speaker isn't fully certain but expects something unwelcome.

sentences.en: I'm afraid it's going to rain.

sentences.pinyin: Tā kǒngpà bù zhīdào zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.en: He probably doesn't know about this.

sentences.zh: 时间不够，恐怕我们去不了了。
sentences.pinyin: Shíjiān bù gòu, kǒngpà wǒmen qù bu liǎo le.
sentences.en: There isn't enough time; I'm afraid we can't go.
